questions.q_en: If sinA + cosA= , then find sin3A + cos3A
questions.q_hi: यदि sinA + cosA = √3 है, तो sin3A + cos3A ज्ञात कीजिए।
options_en: √2/2
0
√3/2
√5/2
options_hi: √2/2
0
√3/2
√5/2
questions.solution_en:
Sin A + Cos A = √3

Squaring both sides:

Sin² A + Cos² A + 2 Sin A Cos A = 3

(Using the identity Sin² A + Cos² A = 1)

⇒ Sin A Cos A = 1 ……(ii)

Sin³ A + Cos³ A = (Sin A + Cos A)(Sin² A + Cos² A - Sin A Cos A)

= (√3) (1 - 1)

= 0
questions.solution_hi:

दोनों पक्षों का वर्ग करने पर:

Sin² A + Cos² A + 2 Sin A Cos A = 3

(समता Sin² A + Cos² A = 1 का प्रयोग करते हुए)

⇒ Sin A Cos A = 1 ……(ii)

Sin³ A + Cos³ A = (Sin A + Cos A)(Sin² A + Cos² A - Sin A Cos A)

= (√3) (1 - 1)

= 0

11
28
30

Total num. from 500 to 550
= 50+1=51
Num. divisible by 3
= +1=17
No. divisible by 11
= +1=5
No. divisible by 33=1
So, total numbers which are not divisible by 3,11 are
⇒ 51 [17+5 1] = 30
questions.solution_hi:

questions.q_en: In an isosceles triangle ABC, AB = AC and AD is perpendicular to BC at D. If AD= 8 cm and perimeter of ABC is 64 cm, then the area of ABC is:

130 cm³

    124 cm²

    120 cm³    

    125 cm³
options_hi:
130 cm³

124 cm²

120 cm³

125 cm³
questions.solution_en:
Perimeter = 64
Semi-perimeter = 32
AB + BD = 32—{1}
AB2 BD2 = 64
[AB - BD] × [AB + BD] = 64
AB BD = 2—{2}
From eqn {1} and {2}, AB =17 & BD =15 → BC =30
Hence Area of △ABC= × 30 × 8 =120cm2
questions.solution_hi:

अतः △ABC का क्षेत्रफल = × 30 × 8 =120cm2

Man per minute = 4/3 litres

Woman per minute = 3/4 litres
Total time together to fill 100 liters of water

= 48 मिनट

    999982

999960

Also, [12-8]=[15-11]=[20-1]=[24-20]
=[30-26]=4[Common digit]
∵ 6 digit largest number =999999
999999 =120×8333+39

999999-39=999960
Now, Required number =999960 - 4=999956

PX = 2
Similarly XQ = 2

questions.q_en:
When a positive integer divided by d, the remainder is 15. When ten times of the same number is divided by d, the remainder is 6. The least possible value of d is:
 जब एक धनात्मक पूर्णांक को d से विभाजित किया जाता है, तो शेष 15 प्राप्त होता है। जब उसी संख्या के दस गुना को d से विभाजित किया जाता है, तो शेष 6 प्राप्त होता है। d का न्यूनतम सम्भावित मान क्या है?
